product_overview: Potentijal is a mobile-first sports training app that lets athletes select sports, log games/practices and workouts, and track progress over time with optional premium analytics and an AI trainer. The app is built with Expo (React Native) and uses Supabase for auth/data and RevenueCat for subscriptions.
core_goals: Allow athletes to log sport-specific games, practices, and workouts with required metrics and data persistence.
Provide a consolidated progress view across sports (graphs, skill maps, consistency) with time ranges and search.
Support multiple sports per user with a clear sport-specific home and easy navigation to logging and history.
Monetize via a premium subscription (RevenueCat) while keeping core logging accessible to free users.
Offer optional premium features including advanced analytics and an AI trainer.

features.name: Onboarding welcome
features.description: Entry screen for new or unauthenticated users to start the signup/onboarding flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding/welcome -> Tap Continue -> Navigate to /onboarding/email-entry
Open app unauthenticated -> Attempt to access / -> See /onboarding/welcome (redirect) -> Tap Continue -> Navigate to /onboarding/email-entry

features.name: Email sign up
features.description: Collect user email, submit to Supabase for verification (magic link/OTP), and handle success or error.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding/email-entry -> Fill email input -> Tap Submit -> See /onboarding/email-verification
Navigate to /onboarding/email-entry -> Fill email input with invalid format -> Tap Submit -> See validation error message
Navigate to /onboarding/email-entry -> Fill email input -> Tap Submit -> Supabase signUp fails -> See API error message

features.name: Home tab navigation
features.description: Authenticated user's primary hub: view sport-specific content, access settings and navigate to sport screens.
user_flows: Sign in -> Navigate to / -> See home content and sport switcher -> Tap sport card -> Navigate to /(tabs)/(home)/basketball
Sign in -> Navigate to / -> Tap Settings icon -> Navigate to /settings
Open app unauthenticated -> Navigate to / -> See /onboarding/welcome (auth gate) -> Tap Continue

features.name: Sport screen (e.g. Basketball)
features.description: Sport-specific dashboard showing quick actions (Add Game, Add Practice), schedule/week view, and stats.
user_flows: Sign in -> Navigate to /(tabs)/(home)/basketball -> See sport dashboard -> Tap Add Game -> Fill required fields -> Tap Save -> Navigate to /history -> See saved session in list
Sign in -> Navigate to /(tabs)/(home)/basketball -> Tap Add Practice -> Leave required fields empty -> Tap Save -> See validation error

features.name: Workouts
features.description: Browse available workouts, start or view workout details, log sets/reps/weights and view summary.
user_flows: Sign in -> Navigate to /workouts -> See workout list -> Tap workout to view details -> Tap Start -> Complete exercises -> See workout summary -> Navigate to /history -> See workout entry
Sign in -> Navigate to /workouts -> See workout list -> Tap workout with no exercises -> Tap Start -> See error or empty-workout message

features.name: Progress (Meals tab)
features.description: Access 'Your Athletic Journey' carousel, open Progress Graphs, search/select exercises and view time-range graphs.
user_flows: Sign in -> Navigate to /meals -> See progress carousel -> Tap Progress Graphs card -> See Progress Graphs screen -> Search/select exercise -> Choose 30/90/180/360 day range -> See graph data
Sign in -> Navigate to /meals -> Tap Progress Graphs card -> Search for exercise with no results -> See empty state or 'no data' message
Sign in (free user) -> Navigate to /meals -> Tap a premium-locked progress card -> See upgrade modal -> Tap Continue -> Navigate to /purchase-premium

features.name: History
features.description: List past sessions (games, practices, workouts) in reverse chronological order and view session details.
user_flows: Sign in -> Navigate to /history -> See list of sessions -> Tap a session -> See session details including date, sport and metrics
Sign in -> Navigate to /history -> See no sessions -> See empty state with CTA to log first session -> Tap CTA -> Navigate to /(tabs)/(home)/basketball

features.name: Profile
features.description: View and edit user profile information such as avatar, name and bio; access social features when available.
user_flows: Sign in -> Navigate to /profile -> See profile details -> Tap Edit -> Update name and photo -> Tap Save -> See updated profile
Sign in -> Navigate to /profile -> Tap Edit -> Upload avatar -> Upload fails -> See upload error and keep previous avatar

features.name: Settings
features.description: Access account-level controls: My Sports, Notifications, Account settings, Premium management, Support & Legal, and sign-out.
user_flows: Sign in -> Navigate to /settings -> See settings list -> Tap My Sports -> View and edit sports -> Tap back -> Return to /settings
Sign in -> Navigate to /settings -> Tap Premium -> Tap Restore Purchases -> Call RevenueCat restore -> See success confirmation -> Premium state updated
Sign in -> Navigate to /settings -> Tap Manage Subscription -> App opens platform subscription management (external) -> User returns to app

features.name: Purchase premium
features.description: Present premium offerings via RevenueCat, allow users to purchase or restore purchases and handle success/failure states.
user_flows: Sign in -> Navigate to /purchase-premium -> See premium options loaded from RevenueCat -> Tap Purchase on a plan -> Complete platform purchase flow -> See premium unlocked and updated UI
Sign in -> Navigate to /purchase-premium -> See premium options -> Tap Purchase -> Purchase fails or App Store error -> See clear error message and option to retry
Sign in -> Navigate to /purchase-premium -> Tap Restore Purchases -> RevenueCat restore fails -> See restore failure message

known_limitations.issue: Expo web may throw "window is not defined" during SSR when Supabase auth uses AsyncStorage
known_limitations.impact: App may not load on web until SSR-safe storage or guards are used
